localChanges: src/lib.rs declares mod long_rpc and applies a 64 MiB cap only to protocol GET thread bounded snapshots; generic HTTP/RPC stays at 8 MiB
src/long_rpc.rs adds rpc_with_timeout over the existing private authenticated websocket factory
src/stream.rs uses the 64 MiB websocket cap only for orchestration.subscribeThread with acceptBoundedSnapshot=true; authentication and other streams unchanged
src/lib.rs adds media_image using the same signed same-origin image grant reader as attachment_image, with exact thread/path scope and existing 10 MiB bound

src/projection.rs keeps the htmlRender reference (attachment id and title) of html_render turn items when the live mirror drops tool outputs, so renders that arrive while a chat is open still reach the timeline

src/lib.rs declares pub mod device_hub; src/device_hub.rs builds only the native device hub proxy paths (MJPEG, screenshot, input sockets) with a session wsTicket and hostId, splits MJPEG/JPEG streams, parses Android SEMU packets and encodes panel input for serve-sim and serve-emu

src/projection.rs applies the partial-payload events of upstream 0.1 (thread.pull-request-link-updated, provider-session.detached, run.background-work-cancelled, checkpoint.rollback-requested), mirrors context handoffs and transfers, and keeps a provider turn's token usage when an update omits it
src/lib.rs attachment_image also reads HEIC, HEIF and AVIF attachments (ISO-BMFF ftyp signature), which T3 renders since 0.1
src/documents.rs reads MCP app references (t3McpApp) of completed tool calls and src/projection.rs keeps them when the live mirror drops tool outputs
src/compaction.rs keeps settled threads asleep: automatic compaction skips a thread whose settledOverride or settledAt marks it settled, unless it was explicitly made active
src/queue.rs hides a queued or cancelled run's message only while that run still owns it, so a message promoted to steer stays visible on the active run

src/lib.rs and src/long_rpc.rs keep a failed RPC's reason after its code ("rpc_rejected: <message>"): only the cause's first error message or error tag is read, bounded to one line; error_code() strips it for callers that compare codes; rpc_connection_failed keeps the websocket handshake error
src/activity.rs marks failed tool rows (`failed`: status failed or output indicating failure) so the timeline can show what failed

src/sidebar.rs follows T3 0.1.2 snooze and status rules: sidebar_status() ports resolveSidebarThreadStatus over presentThreadShell's runtime (approval, input, waiting, working, goal, limited, failed, ready; background work parks at idle, commands hold nothing); metadata() reads V2 thread-level status/lastError, wakes a snooze only on a request or a fresh failure (never on a completed run) and exports wokeAt/woke (threadWokeAt)
